Description: Verify successful booking creation with valid data.
Example Test Case: POST /bookings with valid guest details, date, room type – verify booking created.

Description: Test invalid input – missing fields, incorrect data types.
Example Test Case: POST /bookings with missing ‘guest name’ field – check for appropriate error code.

Description: Retrieve booking information by various criteria.
Example Test Case: GET /bookings/{bookingId} - Verify correct booking details are returned.

Description: Test with edge date ranges, very long names.
Modify existing bookings with valid updates.
Example Test Case: PUT /bookings/{bookingId} - Update guest name and room type – verify changes saved.

Description: Test invalid update requests (e.g., incorrect booking ID).
Example Test Case: PUT /bookings/invalidBookingID – check for appropriate error response.
DELETE /bookings/{bookingId} - Verify booking is removed from the system.
DELETE /bookings/invalidBookingID – check for appropriate error response.

Description: Testing extreme values and limits of input parameters.
Example Test Case: Test with minimum and maximum date ranges, very long names or descriptions.

Description: Simulate multiple users accessing/modifying bookings simultaneously.
Example Test Case: Multiple users attempting to book the same room concurrently – verify data integrity.

Description: Ensure API correctly validates input data types and formats.
Example Test Case: POST /bookings with invalid date format - check for error handling.

Description: Verify user authentication and access control to protected endpoints.
Example Test Case: Attempt to access a booking without valid credentials – verify access denied.

Description: Test API's response to invalid requests or unexpected errors.
Example Test Case: Simulate server error during booking creation - check for appropriate error message.

Description: Assess vulnerabilities like SQL injection, XSS (if applicable).
Example Test Case: Attempt to inject malicious code into input fields – verify protection mechanisms.

Description: Measure API response times under various load conditions.
Example Test Case: Simulate 100 concurrent users accessing booking data - measure response time.

Description: Verify interactions between different API endpoints and services.
Example Test Case: Test the interaction between booking creation and room availability checks.
